description:

If your restaurant is spending money on Facebook or Instagram ads, don’t run another campaign until you watch this.

In this video, Jace from Dineline breaks down how one restaurant generated 1,134 reservations, spent less than $2,000, and drove over $129,000 in revenue—all using Meta’s new ad engine: Andromeda.

You’ll see:
✅ The exact ad campaign structure we used
✅ How Meta’s new AI prioritizes creative over targeting
✅ The 5 creatives we used to win 64X ROAS
✅ A behind-the-scenes look at a live campaign
✅ How to use first-party data with tools like Dishio to supercharge your results

Whether you're a restaurant owner, marketer, or operator—this playbook will help you scale smarter and stop wasting ad dollars.
